items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: The solo was Brunus' solo of Ten Loof Blue. Now I've had the record at home because I used to buy all those records and everything.

ctx.x: So it was strictly one of those schools, you know, a bunch of kids. And they formed a little band, and we did one or two concerts after I'd been with them for a year. So, but I always wanted to play something with a sound. And naturally, just playing trombone parts, they don't sound like nothing. Even the little orchestrations that we would play in this little orchestra set up, there never was any melody, or any tune or anything connected to it. So my mother had been sacrificing and sending me to take these…
Tell me, when did you change over to right handed trombone then?
